## Primary Request and Intent
- Build DSH plugin `dsh-tri-layer-memory` ("三层记忆压缩引擎"): L1 working memory (last N turns verbatim) / L2 short-term (LLM summary, injected) / L3 deep memory (local persistence + `memory_recall`). Self-contained, one toggle, no compatibility problems.
- User refinements, verbatim:
  - "遗忘的逻辑我想的是主内容不遗忘或进入记忆网络，分支内容保留主要部分，其余进入记忆网络，每轮对话的细节部分进入记忆网络，按需取回"
  - "主内容只记住关键重要变动以及任务标题（但是关于重要变动以及任务细节进入记忆网络）"
  - "1.避免三个风险，对于第一个宁可多记忆，对于第二个标题里带一句原因（+15 tokens/条），对于迪桑按事件"

  - "1.思维链每次打开dsh的时候为空，要跑完一轮会话之后才会显示从第一轮会话到最后一轮会话的完整思维 / 完成优先级完成"

- Priority list: 1) long-user-message title summarization → DONE; 2) `cause` field → DONE; 3) README → DONE; 4) 可引用 → DONE; 5) three accounting issues → DONE.

## Key Technical Concepts
- DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 (shipped app); checkout `D:\deepseek\deepseekh_work\upstream\extract` is older 0.1.5-rc.1 — **verify against installed app.asar**.
- `exports.inject` = hard dependency: missing service ⇒ fiber stays `pending` ⇒ host refuses to boot. All services via soft `ctx.inject([...], cb)`.
- Loader `internal/update` handler calls `entry.parent.tree.write()` → rewrites `cordis.patch.yml` from in-memory tree, **destroying user config** when failing rows exist.
- Real Session API: `snapshotEvents(fromSeq, toSeqExclusive)` / `ownEvents()`; **no `events` property**.
- Event shapes: `user/message` body at `data.content`; `assistant/message` and `tool/result` at `data.message.content`; task title only in `agent/inbox/spliced` → `data.inserted[].content`; `tool/result` carries `data.message.toolCallId`; tool name only on `tool/call` → `data.name`.
- Two exit-code formats: `[exit code: 1]` (pwsh) and `[status: completed, exit code: 1]` (job_output).
- `conversation.view` slot (list, session scope): occupants `chat`(0), `trajectory`(10), `memory`(20) — all three confirmed active in live slot tree.
- Session projection: `ctx.sessionProjections.register({key, stateSchema, init, apply, wire:{viewSchema, view}, stateVersion})`.
- **`stateVersion` must be bumped whenever fold semantics change** — the projection cache only treats rows with matching `ver` as usable.
- **Cold-read path for existing sessions**: `sessions.prepare(...)` creates an *unpublished* Session → `registry.restore(checkpoint, events, baseSeq=0)`. Checkpoint is always at log end ⇒ replay window empty ⇒ **`apply` is never called**; `sessions.get(id)` returns undefined for prepared sessions; `session/created` fires after the first frame.
- `reasoningEffort` shares the output token budget: pi-ai `dsh-llm-pi-ai/lib/index.js:1366` "reasoning folded into output by pi-ai".
- `deepseek-v4.1-flash` `thinkingLevelMap: {off: null, low:"low", high:"high", max:"max"}`; `off` filtered out by `getSupportedThinkingLevels` (`:753-761`) ⇒ only low/high/max valid.
- `dsh-llm-pi-ai/lib/index.js:1851`: `options.reasoningEffort ?? profile.reasoning`; profile has no `reasoning:` ⇒ no effort sent.
- `pi-ai/dist/api/openai-completions.js:666-673` (deepseek branch): with no effort, `thinking:{type:"disabled"}` only sent when `thinkingLevelMap.off !== null` ⇒ for this model **nothing is sent** ⇒ gateway default thinking runs.
- Platform convention: `dsh-llm/lib/types/assembler.js:121-126` keeps text on max-tokens, only discards unsafe tool calls.
- Self-update mechanism: `lib/entry.js` thin shell re-imports `./impl.js?generation=<Date.now()>` on every activation ⇒ replacing `lib/` + re-activating reloads without process restart.
- esbuild: `minify: true` + `charset: 'utf8'` (851KB → 404KB). **Minification mangles function names** — grepping `lib/impl.js` for a function name is NOT evidence of absence; grep for string literals instead.
- `conversation.view` standardProps include `inputActions: InputActions` (`setDraft(text)`/`submit()`, `packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/contract/input.ts:229`) and `useInput` (`InputState.draft`, `:329-331`).
- DSH session logs: `session.v4.jsonl.zstd` = concatenated zstd frames (magic `28 B5 2F FD`).

## Files and Code
- `D:\deepseek\deepseekh_work\plugins\dsh-tri-layer-memory\` — plugin root, version **0.1.18**, deps `{@deepseek-ai/schemastery, zod}`.
- `src/host/index.ts` (~1300 lines) — `readEvents()` with `snapshotEvents()` fallback; `refreshDigest()`; `refreshMainline()` (high-water mark); `refreshMainlineCauses()` (fire-and-forget + `CAUSE_INLINE_WAIT_MS = 1500`); `CAUSE_TIMEOUT_MS = 45_000`; `CAUSE_MAX_TOKENS = 4096`; `writeDiagnostics(state, sessionId)` → `<sessionId>.diagnostics.json`; `writeHydrateDiagnostics` → `<sessionId>.hydrate.json`; `hydrateProjectionFeed(session)` / `hydrateProjectionFeedById(id)`; `session/created` + `session/disposed` listeners; `llmSeam()`; `sessionIdOf(session)`.
- `src/host/l1-working.ts` — `messageBody(data)`; `TurnSpan.tokens` (accumulated via `estimateTokens(text)`, NOT `estimateTokens(String(charCount))`); `WorkingWindow.tokens`; `renderWorkingMemory` uses `window.tokens`.
- `src/host/milestones.ts` (~1900 lines) — `Milestone{turn,turnTo?,title,cause,detail,category,tokens}`, `extractMilestones`, `renderMainline`, `stripInjections`, `clipUnit`, `listSummary`, `proseTitle`, `missingCauses`, `renderCauseRequest(slots, excerptChars=120)`, `CAUSE_INSTRUCTION`, `parseCauseReply`, `applyCauses`, `attachCauses`, `causeExcerpt(detail, limit)`, `CAUSE_EXCERPT_CHARS=120`, `CAUSE_EXCERPT_MAX=500`, `causeCacheKey()` = `区间#标题` (unchanged).
- `src/host/l2-short.ts` — `summarizeWithLlm` now **three-state**: `ok` / `truncated` (hit max-tokens but non-empty text → trim at boundary, keep `via: 'llm'`) / `failed` (stream error / abort / **empty text only**). Request carries `reasoningEffort` (default `low`); on `UNSUPPORTED_REASONING_EFFORT` retries without the field. Records finish/usage.

- `src/host/config-core.ts` — flat scalars; `l2MaxSummaryTokens: 4096`; new `l2ReasoningEffort` (`inherit|off|low|high|max`, default `low`); `mainlineCauseExcerptChars` (120, 0–500); `mainlineCauseEnabled/MinBatch(3)/MaxPerCall(20)`; `mainlineEnabled/Inject/MaxMilestones(60)/MaxTokens(2500)`; 33 keys total.

## Errors and Fixes
- Plugin list red "异常" badges: `incompatible-version` on `dsh-compaction-instant@0.1.4`, `dsh-mcp-lens@0.1.0-rc.9`, `dsh-memory-vault@0.1.5` (declare `@deepseek-ai/* ^0.1.0-rc.6` peers vs runtime 0.2.0-rc.2). Fixed by removing all third-party deps.
- App boot failure `1 entry did not activate / dsh-tri-layer-memory: pending (waiting for service: settingsScope)`: client half hard-injected `settingsScope`. Fixed → `inject = ["slots","locale"]` + soft `ctx.inject`.
- Crash-dialog choice truncated `cordis.patch.yml` 267→28 lines, wiping preset registry/models. Restored from `.backup-before-tlm\cordis.patch.yml`.
- **Critical**: `readEvents` read `session.events` (nonexistent) → L1/L2/mainline silently dead. Fixed with `snapshotEvents()` fallback + mutation-verified regression test.
- L1 body-shape bug: read `data.content` for assistant/tool → `charCount` understated ~75×, L2 built from user text only. Fixed via `messageBody()`.
- `estimateTokens(String(charCount))` → reported "约 2 tokens" for a 520K-char window. Fixed by accumulating `estimateTokens(text)` per turn; regression test mutation-verified.
- `l2MaxSummaryTokens: 1024` + `CAUSE_MAX_TOKENS: 512` + `reasoningEffort: max` ⇒ reasoning ate the whole budget ⇒ `summarization truncated at the token cap` / `cause reply carried no parsable entries (0 chars)`. Fixed by raising to 4096, adding `l2ReasoningEffort: low`, and **keeping truncated-but-non-empty text instead of discarding it**. Confirmed live: `finish: "stop"`, `outputChars: 2077`, `outputTokens: 1776/4096`, `via: "llm"`.
- cause timeout 8000ms → 45s + `CAUSE_INLINE_WAIT_MS = 1500` (bounded inline wait; slow calls continue in background).
- 8 tests failed after making cause enrichment fire-and-forget → introduced bounded inline wait instead of reverting.
- Thinking column empty on app start: root cause = prepared cold-read never calls `apply` + `sessions.get(id)` undefined for unpublished sessions + `stateVersion` not bumped. Fixed with `stateVersion 1→2` (forces full replay) + `derive` fallback. Confirmed: `blockedAt: null`, `servedUpdatedAt: 1791512701187`, `fold.applies: 8756`.
- Diagnostics file was a single global file overwritten by whichever session ran last (showed `milestones: 1`, `llmSeam: "none"` from another session). Fixed → per-session `<sessionId>.diagnostics.json`.
- `cause` fabricated causes when the request sent only `{序号, 轮次, 标题}`. Fixed by adding 120-char `detail` excerpts + instruction permitting 「原因不明」. Verified live.
- `cordis.patch.yml` was rewritten to 28 lines at **2026/10/8 17:17:21 (app startup)**, NOT by `set_bundle` (my re-activations verified byte-identical each time). Restored from a 267-line backup.
- Bundle count reported 10 vs an earlier recorded 11; `package.json` mtime matches the `set_bundle` moment. Unresolved — user asked to check the plugin list.

## Pending Jobs
- **`cause` backfill has the SAME root cause as L2** (`CAUSE_MAX_TOKENS = 4096`, diagnostics showed `0 chars`): needs the same treatment (carry a reasoning-effort level + retry-on-reject). Subagent deliberately did not touch it; suggested renaming the key to `internalCallReasoningEffort` and governing both paths. **`l2ReasoningEffort` has never been in any patch, so renaming is zero-migration.**
- cause quality: 「原因不明」 accounts for nearly half of entries; occasional wrong excerpts (entry 8 grabbed "dummy key", entry 18 grabbed "禁用后预设又消失"). Possible fix: excerpt 200–300 chars, or prefer conclusion sentences over the opening.
- L3 record list still shows the whole library and each record lacks a sessionId (other sessions' "第 3 轮" looks like this session's).
- `src/client.js` GROUPS do not expose the `mainline*` or `l2ReasoningEffort` keys (client.js was off-limits); they must be set via the patch's `config:`.

## Current Work
- Deployed **v0.1.18** (177 tests, 75/75 contract) and re-activated via `set_bundle false → true`; patch verified byte-identical (267 lines).
- Confirmed L2 fix live via `session-5b59b635-...diagnostics.json`: `"via": "llm"`, `"truncated": false`, `"failure": null`, `attempt.finish: "stop"`, `outputChars: 2077`, `usage.outputTokens: 1776`, `reasoningEffort: "low"`, `effortRetry: false`, `mainline: {milestones: 52, causeFailure: null}`.
- User replied **"修复剩余问题"** (fix the remaining problems) — i.e. proceed with the pending items above.

## Next Step
- Fix the `cause` backfill path (same root cause as L2): rename `l2ReasoningEffort` → `internalCallReasoningEffort` and apply the reasoning-effort level + retry-on-reject to both the L2 digest call and the cause call; then add tests, `npm run verify`, bump version, `node scripts/deploy.mjs`, re-activate, verify patch MD5 unchanged.

## Critical Context
- Self-update flow (standard): bump version → `npm run verify` → `npm pack` → copy tgz to `<profile>\vendor\` → `node scripts/deploy.mjs` → back up `cordis.patch.yml` → `set_bundle false` → `set_bundle true` → verify patch MD5 unchanged. **Never** use `dsh plugin add`/reinstall.
- Subagents are **not addressable** via `send_message`; spawn fresh ones. Subagents must NOT deploy or bump versions — that is the Lead's job.
- Reading `package.json` once can catch a transient mid-write state — read twice before concluding.
- Compatibility verdicts must be checked against the **installed** 0.2.0-rc.2, not the older checkout.
- Config must stay flat top-level scalars (`SettingsScope.set(field, value)` only writes scalars); the host settings schema must declare every key or panel saves silently reset it.
- Anti-regression gates: client `inject` must stay `["slots","locale"]`; `lib/entry.js` `inject` must be `[]`; mainline must bypass `arbitrateInjection`; `selectPrunable` must exempt milestones; L1 body must read both content locations.
- Verified numbers: reference session (`session-e47420b3`, dsh-live2d, 6.8MB/11,424 events/54 turns) → 54 milestones/1,821 tokens; current session (`session-5b59b635`) → 52 milestones.
- Extraction quality: goal oscillation 10→4 entries; tool-description/error titles → 0; `第 8–11 轮: 连续 4 轮被用户中止` deliberately preserved.
- The plugin has had **four** silent "looks-like-it-works-but-doesn't" failures (`readEvents`, L1 token estimate, diagnostics file scope, projection cold-read). Standing instruction to subagents: "骗我一次比晚交付一小时代价大得多" — report evidence, not "should be fixed".
